g.text: FINITE MANIFEST / ORIGINAL CLAIM / AFFINE STREAM RANGES

text.tspan: Partial offers / reply loss / capability replay schedules
Finite partition / affine prefixes / shared escrow composition
All range quotas within parent hold
Serialize with seal at the writer
No copied tail or owner retagging
Old accepted bytes can still drain
